name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.52.0: Resolve a board to its image and fetch it; Fetch one board's image out of a release zip; Read a release zip from its back end; Check the manifest is for the board we asked for.
changelog.v2.51.1: Do not pick a bootloader as the implicit serial target; Stop calling a UF2 bootloader a radio.
changelog.v2.51.0: Key the Status cursor on a verb rather than a position.
changelog.v2.50.0: Say each Status reading once and give the room to the card in trouble; Measure the Status card's shares 64 bits wide.
changelog.v2.49.0: Draw the airtime trend as a chart with its axes named; Measure several series on one clock window; Offer a trend only when there is a line to draw.
